title: Trace View
description: Find commits that may have introduced a behavior change from your description, with evidence you can verify in Delta View.

confidenceHints.high: Strong match to your question; verify in Delta View first.

compareInDelta: Compare parent → this commit in Delta
noParent: No parent commit for structural comparison.
